findings.issue_text: [ADVISORY] The fail-closed branch returns before the WarningEmitter fires, so an all-rejected output writes no LENS_VALIDATE warn event. Bucket telemetry for the most malformed outputs survives only in the error detail, not as a greppable warn event.

[ADVISORY] A lens whose only real concern can only be anchored to deleted lines (a pure-deletion hunk has no new-side range) now fails the node instead of decoding to nothing. A deletion-only diff with one legitimate out-of-anchor concern ends GATE_FAILED with a fork; recoverable by re-recording.

[ADVISORY] The check ignores d.Truncated, so findings beyond a MaxDiffBytes cut are anchor-rejected and can trip lens_all_rejected with a message blaming the entries. On a very large diff the operator is told to fix entries when the cause is truncation; diagnostics gap, not a regression (before, the loop ended clean).
